name: @crafter/cli
description: Ship projects to the Crafter Station community directory.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --minify && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p='dist/index.js';fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\\n'+fs.readFileSync(p))" && chmod +x dist/index.js
